experiment: SS (D-294): one tight shoe source for the low sneaker, drawn at K = 4 for the avatar's feet region, judged by a fixed placement and a locked evaluation
status: AUTHORISED by D-295 (D-295 SS: 1 CALL AUTHORISED): ONE single-use call, PREPARED AND NOT EXECUTED; the send needs the owner's separate execution instruction; no earlier permission is reused; the plan ss-plan-v1.json stays the unauthorised plan it is

meta.why: authorisation is the exact token in D-295's decision status plus this file's unspent entry, never a general boolean
meta.kind: a bounded source experiment: no catalogue, no runtime, no activation, no item approval, no publication

budget.separateFrom: every earlier budget (D-255, D-258, D-267, D-270 included)
budget.enforcedLimit: the call count (one one-shot claim); the price is an estimate

price.source: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing (Standard, gpt-image-2.5-sunburst: text input $5.00, image input $8.00, image output $30.00 per 1M tokens; no per-image table and no separate snapshot price on the page)
price.basis: image input at most 3,072 tokens (measured for two input images on R1-1 and R1C-1; this call sends one), text input about 500 tokens (the prompt is 1,459 bytes, at 3 bytes per token), image output 1,372 tokens (measured for 1024x1536 high; 1536x1024 has the same pixel count) and at most 1,756 (the largest measured, TPV-1): expected about $0.06, at most about $0.08
price.note: an estimate, not a guaranteed maximum; the billed amount is read on the OpenAI usage page

privacy.cSentToApi: never: C is not part of this call
privacy.referenceSentToApi: the layout reference only: derived from the published low sneaker layer (assets/avatar-northstar/shoes-sneakers-beige-shoes-v1.webp), enlarged
privacy.publishOrTrack: never: the raw result, the placed layers and every review sheet stay outside both clones (D-127 §2)

frozen.noChangeDuringTheExperiment: the reference, prompt, crop, K, downscale, placement, rules and their thresholds are not changed after receipt; any later correction is a new version

request.canvasGenerator: northstar-shoe-source.mjs layoutCanvas from the published layer (deterministic)

placement.rule: the fixed mapping of D-294 (CROP 384x256 at K = 4; premultiplied K x K area average) and one global integer translation from the registration, |dx|, |dy| <= 2 avatar px
placement.noDeformation: never a scale, a rotation, a warp, a per-shoe move, a retouch or a mask; a source that needs one is reported as such

automatic.detail: the silhouette's and the inner lines' transitions at most 2 source px wide (median): drawn at K, not an enlargement
automatic.geometry: each shoe's IoU >= 0.95 with the published shoe, size ratio 0.96–1.04, centre within 2 px; exactly two painted pieces; at most 3 px of C's ankle skin colour; at most 40 px painted over C's ankle where the shoe is open; the covering changes by at most 1 % and exposes at most 20 px of C's foot
automatic.seeds: the cut's 22 seeds land in fields of the new drawing (else its fields need entering once; reported)
automatic.smoothing: per design and field, the line contrast at K >= 0.9 x the published source's at 1x
automatic.outfits: the cream tee over the six bottoms; COMBO-2 is reported as it is

visual: the same pair as the published low sneaker: construction, proportions, angle
the collar top: clean antialiased edge against the ankle, no skin, no light rim, no lining
outlines and seams: crisp, even weight, soft antialiased flanks; not blurred
laces and eyelets: four laces per shoe, readable
upper and toe cap: one continuous seam line
Northstar quality at 1:1, at a labelled 4x and in the browser at 110x165 and 300x450

classes.acceptedForTheChain: every automatic check passed; the visual review follows and decides nothing automatically
classes.rejected: detail, geometry or seeds failed; reported, not repaired
classes.requiresManualDecision: anything else; it does not count as passed

acceptance.scope: one result shows whether a tight K = 4 source gives real extra detail that survives the chain; it approves no shoe

stopRules: a single call: no retry, no reserve, no fallback, no other model
uncertain dispatch: DISPATCHED_RESULT_UNKNOWN, NOT_DISPATCHED, RESPONSE_BODY_UNREADABLE, UNEXPECTED, or a claim without a written outcome — never resent
any HTTP error, moderation block or format error ends the experiment with that outcome
